title: kith-tui: input box never drawn; typed text invisible
description: ui.rs: layout gives the input row Constraint::Length(3), but draw_input() starts with 'if area.width < 4 || area.height < 4 { return; }', so the Input block and the typed text are never rendered. Users cannot see what they type, whether focus is in the input, or that a send failed to clear. Rehearsal1: alice typed 'INVISIBLE' with focus in input; capture-pane shows 0 occurrences and three blank rows above the status line (also visible in smoke1 screen-03-send.txt). Fix: guard on height < 3 (a bordered 1-line paragraph needs exactly 3). Evidence: /tmp/claude-1000/-home-mark-PROJECT-chinwag/d56f3967-d390-456c-a3d8-9501efe458da/scratchpad/rehearsal1/shots/12-alice-typing-invisible.txt
close_reason: draw_input guards height<3 so the 3-row box is drawn; input scrolls to keep cursor visible. Tests: typed_text_and_cursor_are_drawn_in_input_box, long_input_scrolls_to_keep_cursor_in_box
